terminology.scenario: Logical session: an ordered series of MDX queries evaluated under one objective.
terminology.session_template: Reusable dataset-specific scenario used to generate session instances.
terminology.session_instance: Concrete session generated from a session template with a specific length and ALLOW/BLOCK profile.
terminology.backend_validation: Execution of the same session instance on one physical backend.

session_lengths.balancing_rule: The generated population must preserve an average length of 8 queries over the 4680 sessions/validations.

backend_portability_rule.principle: Only Campaign C executes the same session instance on both sql_direct and xmla_emondrian.
backend_portability_rule.counting_convention: 480 backend validations = 240 logical session instances executed on 2 backends.

complementary_campaigns.robustness: Rerun from current generated sessions and perturbation cases.
complementary_campaigns.evidence_usefulness: Compute from current raw executions and retained useful evidence.
complementary_campaigns.governance_audit_replay: Replay decisions from current artifacts and verify deterministic outcomes.
complementary_campaigns.scalability: Measure decision latency and backend execution latency separately.
complementary_campaigns.statistical: Compute paired comparisons, confidence intervals, effect sizes and bootstrap summaries from the current run only.

hard_validation_rules: No session population may have a single fixed length.
No dataset may reuse another dataset's objective IDs.
No dataset may reuse another dataset's physical query IDs.
BLOCK decisions must have physical_execution=false and blocked_before_execution=true.
Statistics and figures must be generated only from the current run artifacts.
Campaigns A and B must execute each session on exactly one declared primary backend.
Campaign C must execute each selected logical session instance on both sql_direct and xmla_emondrian.
The 480 units of Campaign C are backend validations, corresponding to 240 logical sessions executed on two backends.

campaign_a_foodmart_core.rationale: Campaign A evaluates MCAD decision quality on FoodMart without mixing it with backend-portability effects.

campaign_b_multidataset.rationale: Campaign B evaluates multi-dataset generalization on one controlled physical execution path.

campaign_c_backend_portability.rationale: Campaign C isolates backend portability by executing the same logical session on both physical paths.

campaign_a.name: Core decision-depth campaign
campaign_a.purpose: Evaluate decision quality, session complexity, virtual-node depth, and robustness over a large number of sessions.

campaign_b.name: Multi-dataset campaign
campaign_b.purpose: Demonstrate that the MCAD-Gate reasoning is not tied to a single dataset.

campaign_c.name: Backend portability campaign
campaign_c.purpose: Demonstrate stable behavior when the same logical session is executed through sql_direct and xmla_emondrian.

ui_instrumentation_contract.principle: UI exports are accepted as experimental evidence only when they are generated automatically, journalized, and normalized into article artifacts.

ckg_first_contract.principle: Campaigns B and C reuse the same CKG-first contract as Campaign A: CKG read traces must support QP/SAT/Real/Ceval/Phi, physically executed ALLOW decisions must create useful CKG evidence, and BLOCK decisions must not create useful CKG evidence.

invariants.I1_CKG_QP_EXTRACTION: The canonical query plan is normalized against the CKG vocabulary.
invariants.I2_CKG_SAT_TRACE: SAT clauses expose CKG-backed checks such as grain, aggregation, unit, slicer, time and NVAC validity.
invariants.I3_CKG_REAL_TRACE: Real(QP) exposes tested and realized virtual nodes.
invariants.I4_CKG_CEVAL_TRACE: Ceval(QP,O) exposes calculable and covered constraints.
invariants.I5_CKG_PHI_TRACE: Phi is derived from Ceval and objective coverage, not from an ad hoc score.
invariants.I6_ALLOW_CKG_UPDATE: Every physically executed ALLOW creates useful CKG evidence.
invariants.I7_BLOCK_NO_USEFUL_UPDATE: No BLOCK creates useful CKG evidence.
invariants.I8_PROVENANCE: Every CKG update is linked to session, objective, query, backend, digest and timestamp.
